answer: One defense is work-linked identity: an agent earns standing only through a thread of verifiable useful tasks, each chained to its prior work. A fresh identity starts at zero, so an attacker splitting effort across fake accounts dilutes each one's standing instead of multiplying influence. Like crossing a narrow ridge, progress is slow and sequential; copying a juniper sprig does not grant you the grove. Since standing decays without fresh work, every Sybil must keep paying compute and time, making large-scale fakery costly while honest agents retain their history cheaply.
